app.title: Pathways
app.tagline: Where to go. What they provide. When it was last confirmed.
app.disclaimer: Information only. Not an emergency service.
home.heading: What do you need?
needs.stay: I need somewhere to stay tonight
needs.report: I want to report what happened
needs.talk: I need someone to talk to
needs.call: I want to call someone now
search.label: Search
search.none: Nothing matched. Try a shorter word.
status.stale: Confirmed {days} days ago. Re-check before relying on it.
status.unverified_hint: Taken from a document. Not yet confirmed with the place itself.
status.closed_note: Someone reported this place closed. The details are kept so you can check.
offline.banner: Working offline. All information below is saved on this device.
data.offline: No connection. It will update when one returns.
data.failed: Could not load the directory. Connect once so it can be saved to this device.
exit.aria: Leave quickly: clears this screen and opens a neutral website
simple.aria: Toggle a simpler view with bigger icons and shorter text
about.title: About this directory
about.what: This is a list of places that help after violence. It shows where to go, what they provide, and when the details were last checked.
about.not: It is not an emergency service. It does not contact anyone for you.
about.private: Nothing you search or open is sent anywhere. The list is saved on this phone and works without a connection.
about.trust: Every entry shows where its details came from and when they were last checked. Old entries are flagged, not hidden.
about.coverage: Coverage is partial and not exhaustive.
about.poc: This is a proof of concept.
about.exit: The Leave button clears the screen and opens a neutral website. Pressing Escape does the same.
placeholder.label: Example record — not a real service
region.label: Region
directions.straight_line: Straight line, not the road. About {minutes} min walking.
directions.low_accuracy: Your position is only accurate to about {meters} m.
directions.denied: Location is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser settings, or use Google Maps.
directions.unavailable: Your location could not be found. Try again near a window or outside.
directions.tiles_offline: The map pictures need internet. Distance and direction still work.
directions.privacy: Your location is never sent anywhere by Pathways. The map pictures come from OpenStreetMap, which can see the area shown on the map. Google Maps is a separate app and may keep a history.
sos.alert_on: Your SOS alert is still on
directions.straight_line_far: Straight line, not the road. Too far to walk.
directions.privacy_both: The map stays on this place. "Show both on the map" zooms out to include you, and loading those map pictures lets OpenStreetMap see roughly where you are.
